map.偏振光应力检查器 使用指南: Polarized Light Stress Inspector User Guide
map.偏振光应力检查器在正交偏振场下观察镜片干涉色序，查询光程差与应力等级，评估装配残: The polarized light stress inspector observes the lens interference color sequence under a crossed-polarizer field and looks up the optical path difference and stress grade to evaluate assembly residual stress, which suits lens quality control and process improvement.
map.偏光镜下看装配应力与双折射。: Observe assembly stress and birefringence under a polarizer.
map.：偏光+标准灯下无彩纹=应力合格；框压处现彩色条纹且随转镜变化=机械应力，需松框: No color fringes under crossed polars with a standard lamp means the stress passes; color stripes at the frame pressure points that change as the lens rotates mean mechanical stress, so loosen the frame.
map.：应力 0–3 级，≤1 通过；高折/PC 片对应力更敏感，装配力矩须控小。: Stress grade 0-3 with 1 or below passing; high-index and polycarbonate lenses are more sensitive to stress, so assembly torque must stay low.
map.偏光应力和其他应力？: How Does Polarized Stress Compare with Other Stresses?
map.本质都是双折射，偏光法最直观显彩纹；与镀膜应力叠加会加重视觉畸变。: All are birefringence; the polarizing method shows color fringes most intuitively. Combined with coating stress it aggravates visual distortion.
map.装配过紧的应力靠重装松框消除；材料内应力需退火，装配层只能控夹力。: Stress from over-tight assembly is removed by reassembling with a looser frame; residual stress inside the material needs annealing and the assembly layer can only control clamping force.
